import os, urllib.parse, urllib.request
base=os.environ['GALAXY_URL'].rstrip('/')
key=open(os.environ['GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE']).read().strip()
did='f9cad7b01a472135bd6c23cba553c67e'
url=f\"{base}/api/datasets/{did}/display?to_ext=tabular&key=[REDACTED CREDENTIAL]"
text=urllib.request.urlopen(url).read().decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
rows=[]
for line in text.splitlines():
    parts=line.split('\\t')
    if len(parts)>=6:
        pct=float(parts[0]); clade=int(parts[1]); taxon=int(parts[2]); rank=parts[3].strip(); taxid=parts[4].strip(); name=parts[5].strip()
        rows.append((pct,clade,taxon,rank,taxid,name))
print('total rows',len(rows))
print('top 80 by file order')
for r in rows[:80]:
    print('\\t'.join(map(str,r)))
print('\\nTop genus-like rows by clade')
for r in sorted([r for r in rows if r[3] in ('G','G1','G2') or r[3].startswith('G')], key=lambda x:x[1], reverse=True)[:50]:
    print('\\t'.join(map(str,r)))
print('\\nTop species rows by clade')
for r in sorted([r for r in rows if r[3] == 'S' or r[3].startswith('S')], key=lambda x:x[1], reverse=True)[:50]:
    print('\\t'.join(map(str,r)))
PY"

import os,json
from bioblend.galaxy import GalaxyInstance
gi=GalaxyInstance(os.environ['GALAXY_URL'], key=open(os.environ['GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE']).read().strip())
tid='toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/repos/devteam/ncbi_blast_plus/ncbi_blastn_wrapper/2.16.0+galaxy0'
data=gi.tools.show_tool(tid, io_details=True)
print('name',data['name'],data['version'])

def walk(inputs,prefix=''):
    for inp in inputs:
        print(f\"{prefix}{inp.get('name')} [{inp.get('type')}] label={inp.get('label')"'!r} value={inp.get('"'value')"'!r}")
        if inp.get('"'type')=='select':
            opts=inp.get('options') or []
            print(prefix+'  options count',len(opts),'first',opts[:30])
        if inp.get('model_class')=='Conditional':
            tp=inp.get('test_param',{})
            print(f\"{prefix}  TEST {tp.get('name')} [{tp.get('type')}] value={tp.get('value')"'!r} opts={tp.get('"'options')}\")
            for case in inp.get('cases',[]):
                print(prefix+'  WHEN '+str(case.get('value')))
                walk(case.get('inputs',[]), prefix+'    ')
        if inp.get('model_class')=='Repeat':
            walk(inp.get('inputs',[]), prefix+'    ')
walk(data.get('inputs',[]))
print('outputs', json.dumps(data.get('outputs',[]), indent=2)[:3000])
PY"
